question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Indolent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Active**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indolent **means lazy or inactive. (आलसी या निष्क्रिय)

 
 
• **For example- ***He was indolent and spent the entire day lounging on the couch*.
 
 
 
• Marked option **Active **means energetic or engaged in action. (ऊर्जावान या कार्य में संलग्न)
 
 
• **For example- ***Shima ​was active all day and completed all her tasks.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that 'Active' is the most appropriate antonym for 'Indolent.'

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lazy **means moving slowly or without much energy. (मंद-मंद या ऊर्जाहीन)
 
• **Unskilled **means not having or needing special skill or training. (अकुशल, अदक्ष या अप्रशिक्षित)
 
• **Sluggish **means moving or working more slowly than normal in a way that seems lazy. (सुस्‍ती भरी धीमी गति से चलने या काम करने वाला)
